'''Oblique Maneuvers''' were [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] formations designed to be used in conjunction with other ground assault vehicles and [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] to drive enemy forces in a desired direction. Both single and double oblique formations were used, forming diagonal lines that created a plow effect. In a double oblique formation, [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] took the forward position, allowing [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] to target enemy positions softened up by the scout walkers.
